requirements.requirement: Movement: full speed 6 m/s within 0.1 s, jump 7 m/s with gravity 20 only from the ground.
requirements.how: accel 60 ticks (z = 5.75 m) and jump scenario: peak 1.167 m, landing after 41 ticks.

requirements.requirement: Dash: 14 m/s for 12 ticks, cooldown 1.5 s from its start, direction of movement or facing, event dash.
requirements.how: dash scenario with presses at ticks 0, 89 (refused) and 91: events at ticks 1 and 92.

requirements.requirement: Fireflies: capacity 10; picked when XZ <= 1.0 m and height difference <= 1.5 m; picking gives no points.
Lanterns: first lighting costs 10 fireflies, several deposits, nearest acceptable lantern within 2.0 m; +5 per firefly, +100 per first lighting.
requirements.how: deposit scenarios (full: 10 x 5 + 100 = 150, partial, top-up, 2.1 m away).

requirements.requirement: Falling below Y = -10: once, -1 flame, all fireflies lost, wait 60 ticks, respawn at the start with 90 ticks of invulnerability.
requirements.how: fall scenario with 4 fireflies carried, event and snapshots around the respawn.

requirements.requirement: Shade hit: -1 flame, drop floor(carried/2) fireflies 1.5-2.5 m away (480 ticks), invulnerability 90 ticks, recoil 60 ticks; last flame loses at once.
Pulse: 3 fireflies, 5 m (3D from feet + 0.8), stun 120 ticks, push 4 m in 15 ticks, +5 per shade, cooldown 3 s, nothing without enough light.
Safe zone: lit lanterns keep shades out of 6 m; shades inside when the lantern is lit are pushed out within 30 ticks without damage.
Shades: 2 spawn at tick 300 then every 480 ticks on the r=37 ring, state spawning for 60 ticks, detection 12 m.
Fireflies: 20 at distinct standard points at the start, one more at ticks 240, 480... while below 30.
Pause: events paused/resumed, state paused, tick counts but sim_tick, time and positions stand still.
Night 2 (two islands and a bridge): 6 lanterns, 270 s, bridge walkable, no floor beside it.
Bounce pads: night 2 (14 m/s up, 24 m/s toward the other island, about 1.4 s) and night 3 (12 up, 8 m/s toward -Z onto floor 2); velocity locked in the air.
Charm (Bua Gio): picked like a firefly, 600 ticks of 7.2 m/s and dash without cooldown, back after 2700 ticks.
Night 3 (three floors): 7 lanterns, 300 s, cliffs stop Mây, ramps lead to floor 1, off the inner edge she drops back.
Strong wind in night 3: gust of 5 s every 30 s pushing 2 m/s in one direction.
requirements.how: night3_wind scenario: gust window 1800..2099 and 10 m of drift.

requirements.requirement: Drifters (Gio Lac): idle -> chase (carrying >= 5 within 15 m), touch steals min(3, carried) once, flees; pulse makes it flee or drop the loot.
Determinism: same seed + scenario + inputs = identical bytes in all three nights.
requirements.how: Every scenario is run twice and compared byte for byte.

requirements.requirement: Lantern fuel: a lit lantern has 100 fuel and loses 1 per second; at 0 it goes off (event lantern_out), forgets its fireflies but remembers it was lit.
requirements.how: fuel_decay and lantern_out scenarios: fuel 99 at tick 60, 90 at tick 600, lantern_out at tick 120.

requirements.requirement: Refuel: a lit lantern that is not full takes min(carried, ceil((100 - fuel)/10)) fireflies, +10 fuel each, +5 points each, event refuel; nothing carried = nothing happens.
Relight: a lantern that was lit before needs 5 fireflies, +5 each and +40; relight:true in lantern_lit; fuel 100.
Drain: shades walk to a weak lit lantern (fuel < 30), stop within 2 m and drain 5 fuel/s each; event fuel_drain every 60 ticks; chase when Mây is within 6 m; a pulse on a draining shade scores 15.
Safe zone only with fuel >= 30: a weak lantern does not keep shades out; refuelling to 30+ pushes them out harmlessly; wandering shades pick a weak lantern first.
Capacity 10 + 2 per successful lighting, at most 20.

Win at dawn with at least ceil(0.6 x lanterns) lit (reason dawn_survived), score 50 + floor(fuel) per lit lantern + 50 per flame; otherwise lose (reason dawn); lighting everything does not end the night.
